mapper.select: SELECT p.PU_CODE, p.PU_NAME, u.UR_EMAIL FROM publisher p JOIN publisher_id pi ON p.PU_CODE = pi.PI_PU_CODE JOIN user u ON pi.PI_UR_NUM = u.UR_NUM where pi.pi_authority = 'SUPER' and pi_del = 'N' ORDER BY p.PU_CODE ASC;
select * from publisher_id where pi_ur_num = #{pi_ur_num} and pi_pu_code = #{pi_pu_code} and pi_del = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into publisher_id(pi_ur_num, pi_pu_code, pi_authority) values(#{pi_ur_num}, #{pi_pu_code}, #{pi_authority})
mapper.select: select pi_pu_code FROM publisher_id WHERE pi_ur_num = #{ur_num} and pi_del = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into publisher_id (pi_authority, pi_pu_code, pi_ur_num) values("EDITOR", #{puCode}, #{userNum})
mapper.update: update publisher_id set pi_del = 'Y' where pi_ur_num = #{userNum}
mapper.select: SELECT u.UR_NICKNAME AS ur_nickname, u.UR_EMAIL AS ur_email, u.UR_NUM AS ur_num, p.PU_NAME AS pu_name, pi.PI_PU_CODE AS pu_code FROM publisher_id pi JOIN user u ON pi.PI_UR_NUM = u.UR_NUM JOIN publisher p ON pi.PI_PU_CODE = p.PU_CODE WHERE pi.PI_PU_CODE = #{puCode} and pi_del = 'N' AND pi.PI_AUTHORITY = 'EDITOR' ORDER BY ur_nickname ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM publisher_id WHERE PI_PU_CODE = #{puCode} AND PI_AUTHORITY = 'EDITOR' and pi_del = 'N'
select * from publisher join publisher_id on pi_pu_code = pu_code join user on ur_num = pi_ur_num where pu_code = #{pu_code} and pi_authority = 'EDITOR' and pi_del = 'N' order by ur_nickname asc
select count(*) from user join publisher_id on PI_UR_NUM = UR_NUM join book on BO_PI_NUM = PI_NUM where ur_num = #{userNum}

SELECT pi.PI_NUM AS piNum, u.UR_NICKNAME AS editorName, COUNT(DISTINCT b.BO_CODE) AS bookCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.BO_FIN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM episode pe WHERE pe.EP_BO_CODE = b.BO_CODE) THEN b.BO_CODE END) AS publishingBookCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.BO_FIN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM episode ie WHERE ie.EP_BO_CODE = b.BO_CODE AND ie.EP_DATE >= #{inactiveBefore} ) THEN b.BO_CODE END) AS inactiveBookCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.OD_ID IS NOT NULL AND e.EP_PRICE > 0 THEN e.EP_PRICE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS salesAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.OD_ID IS NOT NULL AND e.EP_PRICE > 0 THEN 1 END) AS paidPurchaseCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.OD_ID IS NOT NULL AND e.EP_PRICE > 0 THEN bl.BL_UR_NUM END) AS buyerCount, COALESCE(( SELECT AVG(r.RV_RATING) FROM review r JOIN book rb ON rb.BO_CODE = r.RV_BO_CODE WHERE rb.BO_PI_NUM = pi.PI_NUM AND r.RV_DEL = 'N' AND r.RV_DATE >= #{startAt} AND r.RV_DATE < #{endAt} ), 0) AS averageRating FROM publisher_id pi JOIN user u ON u.UR_NUM = pi.PI_UR_NUM LEFT JOIN book b ON b.BO_PI_NUM = pi.PI_NUM LEFT JOIN episode e ON e.EP_BO_CODE = b.BO_CODE LEFT JOIN buy_list bl ON bl.BL_EP_CODE = e.EP_CODE AND bl.BL_DATE >= #{startAt} AND bl.BL_DATE < #{endAt} LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.OD_ID = bl.BL_ID AND o.OD_STATUS = 'PAID' WHERE pi.PI_PU_CODE = #{puCode} AND pi.PI_AUTHORITY = 'EDITOR' AND pi.PI_DEL = 'N' GROUP BY pi.PI_NUM, u.UR_NICKNAME ORDER BY inactiveBookCount DESC, bookCount DESC, editorName ASC
